data: In fiscal 2024, the year ended June 30, 2024, Microsoft reported revenue of $245,122 million (about $245.1 billion), gross profit (labeled "gross margin" in the filing) of $171,008 million, and operating income of $109,433 million. That gives a gross margin of about 69.8% and an operating margin of about 44.6%. Both are up from fiscal 2023, when revenue of $211,915 million produced gross profit of $146,052 million (68.9%) and operating income of $88,523 million (41.8%). Fiscal 2024 also includes the first partial year of Activision Blizzard, which added $5,729 million of revenue and an operating loss of $1,362 million.
